                        🚀 DEPLOYMENT WORKFLOW
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

HOW IT WORKS (Option 3 - Build on Target):
   1. Copy RDK-Middleware-USB to target Raspberry Pi
   2. Run: ./scripts/start-rdk-app.sh
   3. Script automatically:
      ✅ Checks Docker installation (installs if needed)
      ✅ Builds Docker image from included Dockerfile (~5-10 mins first time)
      ✅ Starts application container
      ✅ Displays access URL

TOTAL SETUP TIME: ~10-15 minutes on first run
SUBSEQUENT RUNS: Just ./ scripts/start-rdk-app.sh (instant)

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                     📋 STEP-BY-STEP COPY TO USB
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Option A: Direct copy to USB drive
   $ cp -r RDK-Middleware-USB /media/YOUR_USB/

Option B: Copy via SCP to target RPi
   $ scp -r RDK-Middleware-USB pi-user@RASPBERRY_PI_IP:/home/pi/

Option C: Zip for portable transfer
   $ zip -r RDK-Middleware-USB.zip RDK-Middleware-USB/
   $ cp RDK-Middleware-USB.zip /media/YOUR_USB/
   (Then unzip on target: unzip RDK-Middleware-USB.zip)

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                 🎯 DEPLOYMENT ON TARGET RASPBERRY PI
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

STEP 1: Copy folder to RPi
   $ scp -r RDK-Middleware-USB pi-user@RASPBERRY_PI_IP:/home/pi/

STEP 2: SSH into RPi
   $ ssh pi-user@RASPBERRY_PI_IP

STEP 3: Navigate to folder
   $ cd RDK-Middleware-USB

STEP 4: Make scripts executable (first time only)
   $ chmod +x scripts/*.sh

STEP 5: Start application
   $ ./scripts/start-rdk-app.sh

STEP 6: Wait 5-10 minutes for Docker build (first run only)
   Watch the output for progress...

STEP 7: Access dashboard
   Open browser: http://RASPBERRY_PI_IP:11078

✅ DONE! Application is running!

Start application (builds Docker image on first run):
   $ ./scripts/start-rdk-app.sh

Stop application:
   $ ./scripts/stop-rdk-app.sh

Restart application:
   $ ./scripts/restart-rdk-app.sh

Check status & logs:
   $ ./scripts/status-rdk-app.sh

View live logs:
   $ sudo docker logs rdk-middleware-dashboard -f

Manual Docker commands:
   $ cd docker-files
   $ sudo docker build -f Dockerfile.production -t rdk-middleware:latest .
   $ sudo docker-compose -f docker-compose.rpi.clean.yml up -d

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                      ⚡ WHAT HAPPENS ON FIRST RUN
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

When you run ./scripts/start-rdk-app.sh for the first time:

1. Script checks Docker installation
2. If Docker not installed → Automatically installs Docker
3. Builds Docker image from Dockerfile.production
   - Installs all dependencies
   - Installs Python packages from requirements.txt
   - Copies application code
   - This takes 5-10 minutes (one-time only)
4. Creates necessary directories
5. Starts container in background
6. Displays: "✅ Application started!"
7. Shows: "🌐 Access at: http://RASPBERRY_PI_IP:11078"

Next runs are instant - just starts existing container!

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                         🛠️ SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

Target Machine:
   ✅ Raspberry Pi 4/5 or any Linux x86_64
   ✅ Ubuntu 20.04+ or Debian 11+
   ✅ 2GB+ RAM
   ✅ 5GB+ free disk space (for Docker + data)
   ✅ Network connectivity

Docker will be auto-installed if not present!

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
                      ✅ QUICK TROUBLESHOOTING
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

"Permission denied" errors:
   $ sudo chmod +x scripts/*.sh
   $ sudo usermod -aG docker $USER

Docker not installing:
   $ curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sh

Container not starting:
   $ ./scripts/status-rdk-app.sh    (see logs for errors)
   $ ./scripts/stop-rdk-app.sh
   $ ./scripts/start-rdk-app.sh

Port 11078 already in use:
   $ ./scripts/restart-rdk-app.sh

Out of disk space:
   $ sudo docker system prune -a
   $ df -h    (check available space)

For detailed troubleshooting, see documentation/
